claims.statement: For internal stoichiometric matrix S and reaction-potential vector g=S^T mu, v^T g=mu^T Sv. With uniform downhill margin eta on active flux coordinates, the mass-balance residual directly bounds those flux coordinates.
assumptions: Chemical potentials and fluxes refer to that boundary
A stated uniform affinity margin on the active support
claims.novelty_boundary: Thermodynamic cycle constraints and integrated stoichiometric/thermodynamic/kinetic formulations predate this task; no novelty claim.
costs: Metabolite activity and standard Gibbs-energy uncertainty
claims.falsifier: A dataset certified to have a strict active affinity margin and small stoichiometric residual but violating the derived algebraic inequality indicates inconsistent uncertainty or a mismatched species/reaction boundary.
claims.next_gate: None for the identity; do not promote as a scientific advance.

claims.statement: There is a reversible detailed-balanced mass-action CRN with deterministic class B+C=2 globally attracted to (1,1,1,1), but whose stochastic count process has closed irreducible positive-recurrent classes Gamma_n in that same real class with stationary support A>=n; consequently the stationary family is not uniformly tight.
assumptions: Four internal species and unit-activity balancing chemostat Q
All effective dimensionless forward/reverse constants equal one
Stochastic mass-action falling-factorial propensities at the stated reference volume
claims.novelty_boundary: Astra U/N77 already reports the same stationary-escape phenomenon for a one-way complex-balanced network. This candidate adds reverse channels and detailed balance. Exact historical novelty is UNKNOWN.
costs: Four species, four reversible pairs and eight oriented channels
For top-phase sampling, Theta(n^3) independent stationary observations and Theta(n^-3) event-time resolution
At least n A molecules loaded
claims.falsifier: Any true listed reaction transition leaving B+C=2 or changing A-B(B+1)/2, or statistically incompatible stationary phase frequencies/D law/net pair currents, falsifies the exact model.
claims.next_gate: Independent reaction-network prior-art audit for detailed-balanced escape across count components; then determine whether the formal chemostat model admits a useful lower-molecularity or biologically grounded realization.
